title: Travon Walker agrees to four-year, $110 million contract extension with Jaguars

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Travon Walker agrees to four-year, $110 million contract extension with Jaguars
sources.description: Travon Walker agreed to a sizable extension with the Jaguars on Friday, keeping the former No. 1 pick in Jacksonville for the foreseeable future.
